_doc: Forge graded-verify rubric for e-commerce/store tasks. Owner-editable. Used by the forge-graded-verify skill: review-boss scores each criterion 1-4 with evidence + feedback. Advisory only — never gates irreversible actions. ADAPT per project; do not drop-in blindly. Pairs with the forge-ecommerce playbook (card handling is scored by payments.json).

criteria.descriptor: 1=lorem/placeholder products shown as real, or fabricated sales/metrics; 2=mostly real data, some placeholders; 3=real catalog with a basic empty state; 4=real product data throughout with honest empty/loading/error states and no fabricated inventory or metrics
criteria.raise: replace placeholder products with real data; render an honest empty state instead of fake inventory; never invent sales figures

criteria.descriptor: 1=read-then-write stock, oversell possible; 2=some guarding but a race remains; 3=atomic conditional decrement or reservation; 4=atomic/reservation decrement proven oversell-safe under a concurrent-buyer test (exactly one wins the last unit)
criteria.raise: make stock decrement an atomic conditional update or reservation row and test two concurrent buyers of the last unit

criteria.descriptor: 1=double-submit creates duplicate orders; 2=partial guard; 3=idempotency key on order creation; 4=unique idempotency key so a double-tap/retry returns the same order, proven by test
criteria.raise: add a unique Idempotency-Key to order/checkout submit and test that a duplicate submit returns one order

criteria.descriptor: 1=flow broken or only unit-tested; 2=pieces work in isolation; 3=cart->checkout->order works in test mode; 4=one real purchase flow works end-to-end in test mode (integration test) with money reconciling in minor units
criteria.raise: run one real cart->checkout->payment->order flow end-to-end in test mode and reconcile the totals

criteria.descriptor: 1=live store/marketplace push or spend without approval; 2=connector active but unclear gating; 3=connectors gated until keys+approval; 4=connectors inactive-by-default, no live publish/push/spend done, order notifications idempotent + draft-gated
criteria.raise: keep store/marketplace connectors disabled until keys+owner approval; make order notifications idempotent and draft-gated
